# Fixtures for `luac` (Lua bytecode / LuaJIT)

Every file here was made for whiff's tests and is released under CC0-1.0. The programs print a fictitious harbour's tide table (Saltmere Harbour). Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/bytecode.sh`.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `tides-5.1.luac` | luac 5.1 | CC0-1.0 |
| `tides-5.2.luac` | luac 5.2 | CC0-1.0 |
| `tides-5.3.luac` | luac 5.3 | CC0-1.0 |
| `tides-5.4-stripped.luac` | luac 5.4 -s (debug information stripped) | CC0-1.0 |
| `tides-luajit.luac` | luajit -b -g (LuaJIT 2.1, GC64) | CC0-1.0 |
